text: Brorg paid for Zahira: he pushed her up by ringing the bell with the palm of his hand. It cost him dearly; of those still down below, he is in the worst shape, and he has bronze burns on his hands. Zahira only remembers a greenish hand with a scar across the knuckles.
note: Zahira holds the uncertain fact fact:un-medio-orco-la-subio-tocando-la-campana (she saw hands, not a face), and the open thread about the greenish hand is public. The identity is revealed with its own discovery or with a secret_revealed.
